nom: Avène Hydrance Rich Hydrating Cream, 1.3 fl. oz.

avis.titre: Cleared up my flaky skin problem, helps keeps my facial skin soft year round
avis.texte: I bought this full-size tube of Avene Hydrance Optimale Rich Hydrating Cream after falling in love with a small sample tube that came in a subscription box. At the time I received the sample, I was battling an unusual case of dry flaky skin that was embarrassing. Within a few days of regular use, my skin looked like new. Soft and clear. The tiny sample lasted a long time, so I didn't hesitate to buy the full-size tube even at this price. I use this every morning and night after cleansing my face. My skin stays soft, even with the dry winter skin and drying indoor heat. My makeup glides on smoothly. This is my go-to moisturizer year round now. Another reviewer mentioned being concerned her product may be counterfeit. I only buy products like this when it says Sold by Amazon and not a third party so I make sure I get authentic, fresh products every time.

Skin cremes I thought I had tried them all, it seems. Not all, a friend recommended Avene,after I expressed admiration for her glowing smooth skin. Some of the smoothness is, I know, due to injections, but not all. She had tried the Avene moisturizer at the recommendation of her dermatologist. She Uses it particularly in the winter when her skin becomes more dry. She paid a lot more for her Creme, than I did. I found it on Amazon, and was very pleased at the price. This is more of a daily facial cream which I use morning and night. I cleanse my face with Cetaphil, and then I add a serum and top it off with Avene moisturizer. I only need some mineral powder, blush and mascara, and my day is set. This moisturizer really makes my skin feel full and hydrated. It is not greasy, and absorbs any oil for a shine-free finish. The formula gives me a supple feel and a matt finish. I have never had sensitive skin, but as I grow older it has changed in consistency. It tends to dry more quickly, and, of course, more lines appear. Based on mybfriend's remarks and from what I have read, Avene has been well tested, is not greasy at all. You only need a small amount on your face and neck, and I use what us left on my hands. This skin care product is made in France, and there are several other components to the skin care line you can try. I am using only this face moisturizer, but may try the other products. I am completely satisfied with this moisturizer. Recommended. prisrob 01- 06 -15

I moved out to Arizona back in 2020 and shortly after that, I became a reptile. My skin would become flaky and peel and I tried several different types of facial creams and lotions with no luck. I went to a dermatologist who recommended CeraVe, and it did help my skin to an extent. It took care of the flakiness, but I would still see the dryness, especially when I looked in the mirror up close. I recently was on Google doing a search and came across this brand. I thought I’d give them a try and though I was skeptical, my skin has not looked this good in years. My skin feels smooth, hydrated and NO greasiness. I highly recommend this product.

This is my 11th order of this product. I originally started using it a few years ago when my dermatologist recommended it during a period of hormonal acne. I’ve been using it ever since. I have very sensitive skin that usually reacts to almost everything, either with redness or breakouts, but I can use this cream comfortably without any issues. It is very gentle, deeply hydrating, and has become a permanent part of my skincare routine. It is definitely worth the price. Even a small amount provides excellent hydration and it lasts a long time. I also love that it has a natural ingredients and is fragrance-free.
I have dry not so sensitive skin. I love the way this smells and feels on my tired parched face.

I love all Avène skin barrier creams, recovery lotions and i just purchased this "Hydrance" cream. Texture is nice, it's unbelievably hydrating but the scent is overwhelming. It caused me a headache. So I decided to return it. Then I thought I'll give it another try and Oh my.... For the love of God, remove that awful scent. The reason I love Avène product is because theyre unscented, except this one I guess :/

This was my first time purchasing the daily moisturizer and I love it! It’s very lightweight but extremely hydrating. It doesn’t leave a residue and my makeup goes over it flawlessly. It lasts all day and my skin feels great!

Life saver! I had a huge reaction to starting tretinoin and was recommended this product and the avene thermal spring water to help. The attached photos are about 6 hours apart. Huge difference! I will say the scent is a bit strong and it is a small bottle for the price.

avis.titre: Fragrance is too strong - Soft skin like baby
avis.texte: **I will not have the “Verified Purchase” label on my review because I bought this in France at the French pharmacy.** It made my skin feel baby soft. I was impressed by that. I did not experience any stickiness, oiliness, itchiness, or irritation. The tube has a small opening so you can control the amount precisely. It’s lightweight, absorbent and easy to apply to the skin. I love everything about it besides the fragrance. It smells nice but too strong! It reminds me of some white colored bar soap I used in the past. Maybe Dove or Lever. I can’t remember. It’s powdery and floral. Due to the strength of the scent I gave it away to my mom. Thankfully she doesn’t mind fragrances because I would hate to waste a good quality moisturizer. I was disappointed because I was looking forward to trying out Avene.
Look at the photo I posted since my review keeps getting removed. Also note the production date is a few years old.
